description.value: midi-qol: While attuned, 2d10 force is added to your Unarmed Strike's own damage roll, so a feature that changes that damage's type (Elemental Attunement) changes it too, and a critical hit doubles it. The extra damage is always dealt: you are asked only for the benefit (hit points equal to the dice rolled, or advantage). Gloves of Soul Catching asks on each strike and keeps the damage as force. No rules text (not SRD; Candlekeep Mysteries).

effects.name: Gloves of Soul Catching (Elemental)
effects.description: Constitution 20 (if lower), and an optional 2d10 rider folded into the unarmed strike's damage roll.
